# scalac 3.8.4's parent trees of A's classes (`teq tasty --positions` of scalac's pickles, generated by
# gen-pos.py): every class's parents, each node with a span, which the whole lean check build's pickles give
# the same trees in this order.
a2/C.tasty APPLY 17 .. 17 a/A.scala
a2/C.tasty SELECTin 17 .. 17 a/A.scala
a2/C.tasty NEW 17 .. 17 a/A.scala
a2/C.tasty TYPEREF 17 .. 17 a/A.scala
a2/C.tasty APPLY 41 .. 41 a/A.scala
a2/C.tasty SELECTin 41 .. 41 a/A.scala
a2/C.tasty NEW 41 .. 41 a/A.scala
a2/C.tasty TYPEREF 41 .. 41 a/A.scala
a2/T.tasty APPLIEDtpt 92 .. 98 a/A.scala
a2/T.tasty IDENTtpt 92 .. 93 a/A.scala
a2/T.tasty IDENTtpt 94 .. 97 a/A.scala
a2/T3.tasty APPLIEDtype 105 .. 105 a/A.scala
a2/T3.tasty IDENTtpt 116 .. 117 a/A.scala
